narrative.overview:
Chimaera is a game launcher that behaves like a quiet console. The ground is near-black, panels are tinted glass separated by hairline rims, and a single accent marks what can be acted on. Game artwork supplies the colour; the interface stays out of its way.

The mood is quiet, precise and Apple-like. Surfaces are rounded at 16px, buttons are soft pills, text is set in the platform's native UI face, and motion is short and eased rather than showy.

Everything routes through runtime tokens so that theme presets and custom themes recolour every component. Treat a hard-coded colour as a defect.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#000000) with a three-step glass ladder (#0a0a0a, #0f0f0f, #141414).
One accent, Dodger Blue (#0a84ff), that themes can swap wholesale.
Hairline inset rims (0.5px) instead of outer shadows by default.
Native UI type, 14px body, weight 600 for actions.
Motion on one shared easing curve, 0.18s to 0.2s.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from a CSS custom property. Presets and custom themes only work because components never hard-code a hex.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the single most important action or focus in a region. Everything else is white at a stated opacity.

rules.name: The White-Alpha Rule
rules.body: Fills, rims and dividers are white at fixed alphas (0.04, 0.08, 0.1, 0.14, 0.2). Do not introduce grey hexes between them.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Size Rule
rules.body: Steps in importance use weight (400, 600, 700) and text opacity before they use a bigger font size.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Themed Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no outer shadow at rest. Shadows and blur come from the active theme through --lift and --blur, never from a component.

dos: Do take every colour from a token (--accent, --glass-*, --text, --muted, --line) so presets and custom themes recolour the whole app.
Do keep buttons as 40px pills with weight 600 labels.
Do define edges with 0.5px inset rims at white 10% or 20%.
Do use the 8px spacing unit and the 16px surface radius.
Do keep the 2px accent focus outline visible on every interactive element.
Do run state transitions on --ease (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)) in 0.18s to 0.2s.
donts: Don't hard-code a hex colour in a component; add or use a token.
Don't add an outer drop shadow or backdrop blur to a component; the theme owns --lift and --blur.
Don't use the accent on more than one primary action per region.
Don't introduce a second brand hue; status colours are for state only.
Don't replace the native UI font stack with a decorative face.
Don't use 1px solid borders where a 0.5px inset rim fits.
